concerns.text: SC‑001 (measure difference in generalization performance between counterfactual and baseline groups) is not covered by any task. No task computes or reports the performance‑difference metric required by the success criterion.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires checksums for all data artifacts. No task creates, records, or validates SHA‑256 checksums for files such as `data/discovered_envs.json`, `data/sensitivity_report.csv`, `data/evolution_results.csv`, etc.

Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline) mandates that every artifact carry a content hash and that changes update the project state file. The task list contains no step that records artifact hashes or updates `state/projects/PROJ-993-llmxive-follow-up-extending-evopolicygym.yaml`.
